fragments.text: Excuse me. Would you mind if I asked you some questions? We're doing a

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 打扰一下。你介意我问你几个问题吗？我们正在进行一项关于交通出行的调查。

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 好的，没问题。

fragments.text: First of all, can I take your name?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 首先，能告诉我你的名字吗？

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 好的，我叫 Sadie Jones。

fragments.text: Thanks very much. And could I have your date of birth - just the year will do, actually. Is that all right?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 非常感谢。那能告诉我你的出生年份吗？只需要年份就行，可以吗？

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 好的，没问题。是 1991 年。

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 那么接下来，请告诉我你的邮政编码。

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 是 DW30 7YZ。

fragments.text: Great. Thanks. Is that in Wells?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的，谢谢。是在 Wells 吗？

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 不，实际上是在 Harborne，不过 Wells 离那里不远。

fragments.text: I really like that area. My grandmother lived there when I was a kid.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 我很喜欢那个区域。我小时候我祖母就住在那里。

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 是的，那里很不错。

fragments.text: Right, so now I want to ask you some questions about

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的，现在我想问你几个关于你今天出行方式的问题。你今天是乘坐公共交通吗？

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 是的，我是坐公交车来的。

fragments.text: OK. And that was today. It's the

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的。就是今天，今天是 4 月 24 号，对吧？

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 不是 25 号吗？……不，实际上你说得对。

fragments.text: And what was the reason for your trip today? I can see you've

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 那你今天出行的主要原因是什么？我看到你手里拿着一些购物袋。

acceptedAnswers: but the main reason I came here was to go to the dentist

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 是的，我买了些东西，但我来这里的主要原因是看牙医。

fragments.text: That's not much fun. Hope it was

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 那可不太好受。希望不严重。

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 不，只是常规检查。没事的。

fragments.text: Good. Do you normally travel by bus into the city centre?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的。你平时去市中心通常坐公交车吗？

fragments.text: Yes. I stopped driving in ages ago because

acceptedAnswers: parking was so difficult to find

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 是的。我很久以前就不开车了，因为停车太难找而且费用太高。

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 我明白了。

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 公交车也方便得多，只需要大约 30 分钟。

fragments.text: That's good. So where did you start your journey?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 那很好。你从哪里上的车？

fragments.text: At the bus stop on Claxby Street.

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: Claxby 街的公交站。

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 拼写是 C-L-A-X-B-Y 吗？

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 没错。

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 你对服务满意度如何？有什么不满意的吗？

fragments.text: Well, as I said, it's very convenient and quick when it's on time, but this morning it was late.

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 嗯，正如我说的，准时的时候非常方便快捷，但今天早上晚点了。只晚了大约 10 分钟，但还是迟了。

fragments.text: Yes, I understand that's annoying. And what about the timetable? Do you have any

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 是的，我理解那很烦人。那时刻表呢？你有什么意见吗？

fragments.text: Mmm. I suppose I mainly use the bus during the day, but any time I've been in town in the evening -

acceptedAnswers: for dinner or at the cinema

fragments.text: - I've noticed you have to wait a long time for a bus - there aren't that many.

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 嗯，我主要在白天坐公交车，但每次晚上进城——比如去吃饭或看电影——我发现等公交车要等很久，车次不多。

fragments.text: OK, thanks. So now I'd like to ask you about your car use.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 好的，谢谢。那现在我想问问你关于私家车使用的情况。

fragments.text: Well, I have got a car but I don't use it that often. Mainly just to

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 嗯，我有一辆车，但不经常用。主要是去超市。也就这些了。

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 那自行车呢？

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 我目前其实没有自行车。

fragments.text: you can rent? Do you ever use those?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 那可以租用的城市共享单车呢？你用过吗？

fragments.text: No - I'm not keen on cycling there because of
. But I would like to get a bike - it would be good to use it to get to work.

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 没有——我不喜欢在那里骑车因为污染太严重。不过我想要一辆自行车，骑车上班会不错。

fragments.text: So why haven't you got one now?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 那为什么现在没买呢？

fragments.text: Well, I live in a flat
and it doesn't have any storage - so we'd have to leave it in the

sentences.speaker: Sadie
sentences.translation: 嗯，我住在二楼的一套公寓里，没有任何储物空间，所以只能把车放在公寓外的楼道里。

fragments.text: I see. OK. Well, I think that's all ...

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 我明白了。好的。好吧，我想这就是全部……

title: 交通出行调查 (Survey on transport)
